summary_1line: Rama and Lakshmana visit a hermitage where Vishwamitra recounts how Kama was burned by Shiva and became the bodiless Ananga.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shiva opens his blazing third eye and Kama is reduced to ashes before the startled celestial beings and Parvati.
At dawn on the riverbank, Rama and Lakshmana stand with folded hands offering water to the rising sun.
Rama, Lakshmana, and Vishwamitra approach a tranquil forest hermitage where ascetics await them among huts and sacred fires.
